content.text:
Here’s what was added and how it fits together.

### `PortalEmailThreadWindow` (`packages/ui-lib/src/custom-components/Chat/PortalEmailThreadWindow.tsx`)
- **Thread:** One vertical stream of **email-style cards** (`<article>`): sender, full date/time (`<time dateTime=…>`), optional **subject**, body (`whitespace-pre-wrap`), and **attachments** as `DownloadableItem` **row** variants.
- **Side-by-side roles:** Requester lines use a **primary** left border; PROCERTUS lines use a **muted** left border.
- **Scroll:** Reuses `ChatList` (same pattern as `PortalChatWindow`).
- **Optional `threadSummary`:** Title + subtitle above the list (dossier context).
- **Composer:** Optional **subject** (when `onSubjectChange` is passed), **pending attachments** above the textarea (inline `DownloadableItem` + delete), **file** input + paperclip button (`FileAttachmentIcon`) when `onPickFiles` is set, and `ChatComposerToolbar` with **`composeStyle: "email"`** (no emoji / @ by default). Wraps the textarea + attach button in a **`<form>`** when attachments are enabled.

### Types (`packages/ui-lib/src/components/portal-chat/portal-email-thread-types.ts`)
- `PortalEmailMessage`, `PortalEmailAttachment`, `PortalEmailComposerProps`, `PortalEmailThreadWindowProps`, `PortalEmailThreadSummary`.

### Exports
- Wired through `packages/ui-lib/src/components/portal-chat/index.ts` (and thus `@procertus-ui/ui-lib`).

### Chat toolbar options
- `PortalChatComposerToolbarOptions` now includes optional **`hideMentionButton`** (used by the email composer together with `composeStyle`).

### Storybook
- `packages/ui-lib/src/custom-components/Chat/PortalEmailThreadWindow.stories.tsx` — read-only default + interactive story with staged attachments.

### Prototype app
- **`conversation_detail_panel.tsx`** uses `PortalEmailThreadWindow` instead of `PortalChatWindow`, with **subject + body + file staging**, **blob URLs** for picked files, **revoke** on remove / scenario change, and **CoverView** title **“Dossiercommunicatie”**.
- **`conversation-detail-panel-mocks.ts`:** `MockPortalChatLine` extended with **`subject`** and **`attachments`**; sample PDF-style rows use public assets like `/favicon.svg` and `/icons.svg` as download `href`s.

Import the new API from `@procertus-ui/ui-lib` the same way as `PortalChatWindow`:

```ts
import {
  PortalEmailThreadWindow,
  type PortalEmailMessage,
} from "@procertus-ui/ui-lib";
```

`packages/ui-lib` **`bun run build`** (tsc) passes. The onboarding app build failed on an existing **`react-dom` types** issue in `ui-certification`, not on these changes.

content.text:
Here’s what changed for **Markdown authoring** (TipTap) and **Markdown display** (`react-markdown` + remark-gfm).

### Composer — TipTap Markdown
- New `EmailThreadMarkdownEditor` wraps `@tiptap/react` + `StarterKit` (limited: **bold/italic/strike**, **## / ###**, **bullet/numbered lists**, **blockquote**, **`@tiptap/extension-link`** with autolink/paste).
- **`@tiptap/markdown`** + `contentType: 'markdown'` for load/store; `onChange` emits `editor.getMarkdown()`.
- **Cmd/Ctrl+Enter** and the send chip match the previous chat UX; **`nestedInForm`** avoids nesting `<form>` when the attachment row wraps you in one.
- Toolbar icons use **`@hugeicons`** (replacing lucide — **removed `lucide-react`** from `@procertus-ui/ui-lib`).

### Thread body — read-only Markdown
- New `EmailThreadMarkdownBody` uses **`react-markdown`** + **`remark-gfm`**, with token-based styling and **link scheme allowlist** (`http` / `https` / `mailto` / same-site relative paths).

### Wiring
- `PortalEmailThreadWindow` **replaces** `ChatComposerToolbar` with `EmailThreadMarkdownEditor` and renders each message with `EmailThreadMarkdownBody`.
- Types: `PortalEmailMessage.body` and composer `value` are documented as **Markdown**; obsolete **`composeStyle`** was removed from `PortalEmailComposerProps`.
- Prototype mock line uses `**aangevulde profielgegevens**` as a sample.

### Dependencies (`packages/ui-lib/package.json`)
- Added: `@tiptap/core`, `@tiptap/pm`, `@tiptap/react`, `@tiptap/starter-kit`, `@tiptap/markdown`, `@tiptap/extension-placeholder`, `@tiptap/extension-link`, `react-markdown`, `remark-gfm`.
- Removed: `lucide-react` (only consumer was this editor).

Key files: `email-thread-markdown-editor.tsx`, `email-thread-markdown-body.tsx`, `PortalEmailThreadWindow.tsx`, `portal-email-thread-types.ts`, `PortalEmailThreadWindow.stories.tsx`, and the small mock tweak in `conversation-detail-panel-mocks.ts`.

content.text:
Here’s what was going wrong and what we changed.

### Why the whole composer looked “off” with an empty draft

`InputGroup` is styled with Tailwind’s **`has-disabled`** variants (`has-disabled:opacity-50`, muted background, etc.). Those apply when **any descendant** has native `disabled`. The send button used `disabled={true}` while the draft was empty, so **one disabled send control** made the **entire** compose area look disabled.

### Fix (empty draft no longer uses native `disabled` on send)

- **`sendHardDisabled`** — only real blocks: no editor, destroyed editor, `disabled` / `readOnly`, `hideSend`, `sendForced`.
- **Empty draft** — send stays **`disabled={false}`** so the group doesn’t get `has-disabled`, but we set **`aria-disabled={sendHardDisabled || sendEmpty}`** so assistive tech still knows sending isn’t meaningful until there’s content (clicks still call `submit()`, which no-ops when empty).
- **`pointer-events-none`** on the tooltip wrapper only when **`sendHardDisabled`**, not when the draft is merely empty.

### TipTap / ProseMirror padding

Replaced tight `px-3 py-2` on the editable with **horizontal `px-section`** (your spacing token) and **`py-4`** for stable vertical rhythm inside the contenteditable.

    editor.isDestroyed ||
    blockedRef.current.disabled ||
    blockedRef.current.readOnly ||
    blockedRef.current.hideSend ||

Here’s what was added.

### Behaviour
- **Top-right (`SidebarBottom`)** button when the composer is expanded (editable, not fullscreen): minimizes the composer to a **single row** so the transcript area can grow. Any open **fullscreen compose dialog** closes when you dock.
- **Collapsed row**: shows a plain-text **peek** of the draft (stripped Markdown) or the placeholder; **whole row + icon** restores the full composer (`SidebarTop`).
- **Read-only mode**: no dock UI; if the thread becomes read-only, the composer **automatically expands** again so you’re not stuck docked.

### Layout
- `PortalEmailThreadWindow` outer container now uses **`flex-1`** (with existing `min-h-0`) so the message list can use the freed vertical space above the shrunk strip.
- Composer is wrapped in **`shrink-0`** so the tall editor doesn’t get squashed wrongly in flex layouts.

Implementation lives in `PortalEmailThreadWindow.tsx`: local state `composerDocked`, helpers `dockComposer` / `expandComposer`, `emailDraftPeek()` for the one-line preview, NL `aria-label`s for the dock/expand controls.
